intent: Context Telemetry Event Store. TelemetryEventStore is the append-only port. Test its contract with an in-memory stub: append(TelemetryRecord) emits the stored record; findLatestInRange returns, per (deviceId, metric, tDevice), only the highest revision with tDevice in [from, to], ordered by tDevice ascending. Assert that the interface declares only append and findLatestInRange (no update/delete).

methods.signature: Flux<TelemetryRecord> findLatestInRange(String deviceId, String metric, Instant from, Instant to)
